screen.archetypes.picker.prompt: Choose deliberately — changing your mind later has a price.
screen.archetypes.picker.fork_hint: Pick one path — the other locks.
screen.archetypes.confirm.title: Become a %s?
screen.archetypes.confirm.body: You will start as a %s and can grow into a %s. Changing your path later will come at a price.
screen.archetypes.tree.title: %s Skill Tree
screen.archetypes.tree.reset.tooltip: Creative only. Clears your choice so you can pick again.
message.archetypes.night_form.locked: The night still holds you — %s min
screen.archetypes.tree.legend.capstones: Purple-ringed nodes are capstones. Capstones lock each other out — pick one.
screen.archetypes.tree.legend.elements: An Elementalist commits to one element: choosing Fireball locks Ice Blast, and each element's capstones follow.
screen.archetypes.tree.legend.reset: To reset your nodes, brew an Awkward Potion with a Red Mushroom into a Potion of Amnesia. Resetting costs part of your levels; the stronger brew forgets your archetype entirely.
screen.archetypes.tree.rate.tooltip.coun: You have earned %s — that is x%s right now.
screen.archetypes.tree.mastered: Full potential unlocked — you are now a true %s.
node.archetypes.crusher.clinch.desc: Take and deal 50/100% less knockback (requires both hands empty).
node.archetypes.crusher.sunder.desc: Your hits pierce armor like Breach: level I/II with the mace, II/IV with bare fists. Stacks with the enchantment.
node.archetypes.crusher.bare_knuckle.des: Mace damage increased by 1/2/3/4. Unarmed damage increased by 2/4/6/8.
node.archetypes.crusher.iron_skin.desc: +1/2/3 armor and +1/2/3 armor toughness (requires both hands empty).
node.archetypes.crusher.haymaker.desc: Your next punch deals x4.0 damage, applies Slowness VI for 1.5s and Knockback II. Cooldown starts only on a hit. 20s cooldown (requires both hands empty).
node.archetypes.crusher.meteor.desc: Mace smashes deal 0.5/1 bonus damage per block fallen, like Density. Stacks with the enchantment.
node.archetypes.crusher.shockwave.desc: A mace hit landed while falling deals its full damage to everything within 2/4 blocks of the target.
node.archetypes.crusher.earth_shatter.de: If Quake hits no creature: refund 33/66/100% of its cooldown and shatter every block up to stone hardness within 2/4/6 blocks. Costs one mace durability per block broken.
node.archetypes.crusher.quake.desc: Charge for 1.5s (immune to knockback), then slam for x1.5 attack damage +1.5 damage per Density level +2 damage per Meteor rank, launching hostiles up. 30s cooldown (requires a mace in main hand).
node.archetypes.crusher.battle_trance.de: Every mace or fist hit banks temporary health: 1 per hit with a mace, 2 with bare fists. Caps at 2/4/6 by rank. Starts decaying at 1 per second, 5 seconds after your last hit.
node.archetypes.verdict.not_connected: Locked — connect it to a node you own
node.archetypes.verdict.tree_full: This tree is at its point cap
node.archetypes.verdict.exclusive_taken: Locked — you chose the other capstone
node.archetypes.protector.bash.desc: Bash the nearest enemy in front of you for 5 damage. 7s cooldown (requires a shield).
node.archetypes.protector.slam.desc: The bash deals x1.33/x1.67/x2.0 damage. Its cooldown grows by 2/4/6 seconds.
node.archetypes.protector.cooldown.desc: Removes 1.6/3.2/4.8 seconds from the bash's cooldown.
node.archetypes.protector.knockback.desc: Blocking slows you 33/66/100% less. You still can't sprint while blocking.
node.archetypes.protector.wide.desc: The bash hits everyone in front of you. Extra targets take 50/100% damage. Shield Sweep's reach grows by 1/2 blocks instead.
node.archetypes.protector.spikes.desc: Melee attacks you block hit the attacker with Thorns V/X/XV.
node.archetypes.protector.rush.desc: While blocking, press sprint to lunge forward 2/4/6 blocks. 3s cooldown.
node.archetypes.protector.reflect.desc: Projectiles you block fly back at their shooter. Arrows return at x0.5/x1.0 of their damage by rank.
node.archetypes.protector.omni_block.des: While blocking, your shield stops attacks from every direction.
node.archetypes.protector.ground_slam.de: Shield bash will hit enemies in a wider cone. Shield bash damage is increased by the damage of your currently equipped weapon. Holding two shields will deal x4.0 bash damage. Wide Swings increases the range even further by 1/2 blocks in front of the player.
node.archetypes.protector.spearwall.desc: Shields held by you take less durability damage: they count as having 1 extra level of Unbreaking, stacking with the real enchantment up to a total of 4.
node.archetypes.protector.braced.desc: Every hit your shield blocks reduces bash's cooldown by 1 second.
node.archetypes.protector.taunt.desc: Holding the shield forces hostile creatures within 8 blocks to attack you.
node.archetypes.slayer.slowness.desc: Sword and greatsword hits apply Slowness I/II for 3 seconds.
node.archetypes.slayer.taste_of_blood.de: Kills with sword or greatsword restore 1/2/3 health.
node.archetypes.slayer.lunge.desc: While sprinting, sword swings fling you 1/2 blocks in the direction you're looking, including upward. 2s cooldown.
node.archetypes.slayer.blade_dance.desc: Sword hits have a 25/50% chance to also hit another enemy within 3.5 blocks, in any direction. Bladestorm hits don't count.
node.archetypes.slayer.kbres.desc: While a greatsword is in hand, you have 30/60% knockback resistance.
node.archetypes.slayer.bleed.desc: Sword hits cause bleeding: 1/2/3 damage per second for 3s.
node.archetypes.slayer.heavy.desc: The greatsword hits 10/20/30% harder and swings 10/20/30% slower to match.
node.archetypes.slayer.firstblood.desc: Greatsword hits on full-health targets deal 40% more damage.
node.archetypes.slayer.executioner.desc: Greatsword hits instantly kill targets below 15% health.
node.archetypes.slayer.bloodlust.desc: Sword and greatsword kills grant Speed I for 3 seconds.
node.archetypes.slayer.bladestorm.desc: Spin for 3s, hitting everything within 3 blocks 6 times for x0.5 damage each. 45s cooldown (requires a sword in main hand).
node.archetypes.slayer.decimate.desc: Charge for 1s (slowed), then hit everything within 3.5 blocks in front of you for x3.0 damage. A parry triggers it instantly. 30s cooldown (requires a greatsword in main hand).
node.archetypes.slayer.relentless.desc: Decimate's cooldown drops to 15 seconds, Bladestorm's to 30.
node.archetypes.marksman.true_shot.desc: Your next bow/crossbow shot is unaffected by gravity and deals x2.0 damage. 20s cooldown.
node.archetypes.marksman.seeker_arrow.de: True Shot now automatically shoots at nearby hostile target, passing through neutral. True Shot damage bonus removed, cooldown reduced by 10 seconds.
node.archetypes.marksman.snap_shot.desc: True Shot damage bonus increased to x4.0 and shoots an arrow immediately on use.
node.archetypes.assassin.shadow_step.des: Teleport behind the target creature up to 16 blocks away and strike it once with your dagger. 15s cooldown.
node.archetypes.assassin.shadow_flurry.d: Shadow Step's strike deals +x1.5 damage. Cooldown increased to 30s.
node.archetypes.shadow.predator.desc: Kills while invisible renew the invisibility duration.
node.archetypes.shadow.last_shadow.desc: When you would die, survive instead: negative effects are removed, you get 2s of immunity and turn invisible. Shares a 180s cooldown with Invisibility.
node.archetypes.elementalist.fireball.de: Shoot a fireball that explodes in a 4x4 area for 5 damage and sets targets on fire for 5s. 50 mana (requires a wand in main hand).
node.archetypes.elementalist.meteorite.d: Drop a meteor that spends all your mana (100 minimum). At 100 mana: 16 damage across 5x5 blocks and a Knockback I shove from the crater. Damage, area, knockback, size and sound all scale with the mana spent — 250 mana is x2.5 everything. Cast with Ability 4. Cost reducers refund their share after the blast. Needs open sky above the target.
node.archetypes.elementalist.flamethrowe: Hold Ability 4 to spray bolts of fire, each dealing 2 damage and igniting for 3 seconds. Costs 50 mana to ignite, then 25 mana per second held.
node.archetypes.wizard.magic_missile.des: Fire a magic missile that flies up to 16 blocks and deals 6 damage. 25 mana (requires a wand in main hand).
node.archetypes.wizard.seeker_missile.de: Missiles steer toward the nearest enemy, but fly 33% slower.
node.archetypes.wizard.lance.desc: Missiles pierce every enemy they pass and strike a wider path.
node.archetypes.priest.holy_light.desc: Throw a ball of light: on impact, heals creatures within 4 blocks for 5 health and deals 5 damage to undead. 50 mana (requires a wand in main hand).
node.archetypes.priest.renewal.desc: Holy Light also grants Regeneration for 10 seconds to non-hostiles.
node.archetypes.priest.benediction.desc: Holy Light also grants a random blessing for 10 seconds to non-hostiles: Speed, Strength, Resistance or Fire Resistance.
item.archetypes.spellcasting_tome.no_spe: Needs the Skill Proficiencies mod to level Spellcasting
node.archetypes.marksman.conservation.de: Arrows have a 12.5/25/37.5/50% chance to not be consumed.
node.archetypes.marksman.pinning.desc: Arrow hits apply Slowness I/II for 3 seconds.
node.archetypes.marksman.nimble_draw.des: Reduce penalty for holding the bow drawn by 33/66/100%.
node.archetypes.marksman.rapid_reload.de: Kills with crossbow makes the next reload time 25/50/75/100% shorter.
node.archetypes.marksman.combustion.desc: Hitting a burning target detonates it: everything within 3 blocks takes the arrow's full damage.
node.archetypes.marksman.focus.desc: Reduces True Shot cooldown by 10 seconds on each successful hit on any creature.
node.archetypes.marksman.acrobatics.desc: While drawing a bow, press sprint to roll 2/4 blocks forward. 8s cooldown.
node.archetypes.marksman.piercing_tips.d: Bow and crossbow shots ignore 2 points of the target's armor.
node.archetypes.shadow.umbral_sight.desc: Hostiles within 8/16 blocks are highlighted while sneaking.
node.archetypes.shadow.swift_shadow.desc: Speed penalty for sneaking is reduced by 50/100%.
node.archetypes.shadow.dark_mending.desc: Regenerate 2 health every 8/6/4/2 seconds while invisible.
node.archetypes.shadow.dim_presence.desc: Reduce the range hostiles can see you while sneaking by 20/40%.
node.archetypes.shadow.cleansing_veil.de: Casting Invisibility cleanses the negative effects.
node.archetypes.shadow.first_strike.desc: Your dagger hits from invisibility deal 25/50% more.
node.archetypes.shadow.bloodrush.desc: For 4s after a kill while invisible, dagger hits deal 10/20% more damage.
node.archetypes.shadow.ghost_armor.desc: Your armor turns invisible with you.
node.archetypes.shadow.night_stalker.des: While invisible at night, you get Jump Boost II and Slow Falling.
node.archetypes.assassin.lightfoot.desc: Holding a dagger increases movement speed by 10/20/30%.
node.archetypes.assassin.sidestep.desc: Chance to dodge an attack while holding a dagger: 10/20%.
node.archetypes.assassin.crippling_poiso: Dagger hits apply Slowness I/II for 4 seconds.
node.archetypes.assassin.expose.desc: Dagger damage dealt to targets below half health increased by: 10/20/30%.
node.archetypes.assassin.venom.desc: Dagger hits apply Poison I/II for 4 seconds.
node.archetypes.assassin.blight.desc: Dagger hits apply Wither I/II for 3 seconds.
node.archetypes.assassin.flense.desc: Dagger hits ignore 30/60% of the target's armor.
node.archetypes.assassin.twin_fangs.desc: Shadow Step also strikes with your off-hand dagger, if equipped.
node.archetypes.elementalist.ice_blast.d: Shoot an ice bolt that explodes in a 4x4 area for 4 damage and Slowness III for 4s. 50 mana (requires a wand in main hand).
node.archetypes.elementalist.scorch.desc: Fireballs deal +2/4 damage. The flamethrower's bolts deal +1/2 damage.
node.archetypes.elementalist.vaporize.de: Fireballs remove water in their blast area. Flame bolts evaporate the water block they hit.
node.archetypes.elementalist.frostbite.d: Ice Blast applies Slowness IV/V for 5/6 seconds.
node.archetypes.elementalist.shatter.des: Slowed or freezing targets take +15/30% damage from your fire and ice projectiles.
Ice projectiles turn water they fly over into frosted ice you can walk on.
node.archetypes.elementalist.glacial_spi: Shoot an ice spike at one target: x2.0 Ice Blast damage (x10.0 against slowed or frozen targets) and freeze it for 12s. Ability 4. 75 mana.
node.archetypes.elementalist.blizzard.de: Create a blizzard on a 5x5 area: 20 damage over 8s. Recasting moves it. Ability 4. 75 mana.
node.archetypes.elementalist.spellweaver: All your spells cost 10% less mana.
node.archetypes.elementalist.arcane_powe: Your fire and ice spells deal 20% more damage.
node.archetypes.wizard.mana_shield.desc: 50% of damage taken drains mana instead of health, 2 mana per damage (requires a wand in main hand).
node.archetypes.wizard.overwhelm.desc: +20% missile damage against anything already wounded.
node.archetypes.wizard.concussion.desc: Missiles apply Weakness I for 3 seconds.
node.archetypes.wizard.shatterpoint.desc: +30% missile damage against targets at full health.
node.archetypes.priest.lumen.desc: Holy Light's healing and damage to the undead increased by 1/2.
node.archetypes.priest.fervent_cast.desc: Holy Light flies 50% faster and flatter, reaching farther.
node.archetypes.priest.wrath.desc: Holy Light's damage to the undead increased by 2/4.
node.archetypes.priest.immolation.desc: Holy Light sets undead enemies on fire for 3/6 seconds.
node.archetypes.priest.aegis.desc: Casting Holy Light gives you 4/8 absorption for 30s.
node.archetypes.priest.sanctuary.desc: Casting Holy Light gives friendly targets 4/8 absorption for 30s.
node.archetypes.priest.judgement.desc: Holy Light applies Weakness I/II to undead enemies for 6 seconds.
node.archetypes.priest.ascendant.desc: Multiplies Holy Light's healing and its damage to the undead by x1.25.
item.archetypes.blaze_wand.tooltip: Fire spells cost 15 less mana and deal x1.5 damage
item.archetypes.breeze_wand.tooltip: Frost spells cost 15 less mana and deal x1.5 damage
item.archetypes.holy_wand.tooltip: Priest spells cost 15 less mana and heal x1.5 stronger
item.archetypes.oracle_wand.tooltip: All spells cost 10% less mana and deal x1.5 damage
node.archetypes.oracle_elementalist.ligh: Strike a hostile up to 32 blocks away with lightning for 40 damage. 150 mana (requires a wand in main hand).
node.archetypes.oracle_elementalist.chai: Lightning Strike will chain to 1/2/3 nearby hostile creatures, each within 8 blocks of the last, dealing 100% of the original damage.
node.archetypes.oracle_elementalist.recu: Lightning will strike 1/2/3 more times for 100% of the original damage.
node.archetypes.oracle_elementalist.orac: Regenerate 2.5/5% of max mana per second.
node.archetypes.oracle_elementalist.temp: Lightning Strike becomes an AOE targeted ability, striking every hostile creature within 5 blocks of your aim, and will consume 25 mana for each additional hostile creature struck.
node.archetypes.oracle_elementalist.over: Lightning Strike damage is increased by 100%.
node.archetypes.oracle_wizard.magic_arma: Turn your wand into a magic sword (12.5 damage per hit; with Spellbow, a bow doing 13 damage per full-draw arrow). 50 mana, then 10 mana/s while active (requires a wand in main hand).
node.archetypes.oracle_wizard.magic_armo: During the Magic Armaments channel, every mana spent also provides 0.5/1 temporary health, up to 10/20.
node.archetypes.oracle_wizard.levitation: During the Magic Armaments channel, you are able to glide.
node.archetypes.oracle_wizard.ward.desc: During the Magic Armaments channel, you are immune to negative status effects.
node.archetypes.oracle_wizard.mind_over_: Magic Armaments weapons ignore 30% of armor and deal double damage.
node.archetypes.oracle_wizard.blink.desc: Swings with the magic sword teleport you up to 8 blocks forward when not targeting any hostile creature.
node.archetypes.oracle_wizard.spellbow.d: Magic Armaments will now summon a bow instead of a sword. Its draw is 75% shorter — the Archery skill stacks on top of that, up to 90% — and it uses no arrows, and its arrows fall at a quarter of normal gravity.
node.archetypes.oracle_wizard.mana_sipho: Hits with the spellbow restore 50 mana.
node.archetypes.oracle_priest.aura_of_ra: Casting Holy Light will apply Aura of Radiance to yourself for 10 seconds. Undead creatures within 8 blocks take 1 damage every second. Friendly creatures are healed 1 health every second. Holy Light costs 100% more mana.
node.archetypes.oracle_priest.brilliance: Aura of Radiance damage/healing increased to 2/4 per second.
node.archetypes.oracle_priest.beacon_of_: Aura of Radiance duration increased to 30 seconds.
node.archetypes.oracle_priest.blinding_l: Aura of Radiance afflicts nearby undead creatures with Weakness II and Slowness II while active.
Aura of Radiance grants knockback immunity to yourself.
node.archetypes.oracle_priest.retributio: Aura of Radiance grants you Strength II and Speed II while active.
node.archetypes.nemesis_shadow.dark_ritu: Transform into Night Form (10s channel; any action except moving cancels it for free; once done, you can't change back for 1 hour). In Night Form: no health regeneration, hunger stays full, kills heal 25% of the victim's max health. Healing potions and Priest healing hurt you, and sunlight burns and blinds you.
node.archetypes.nemesis_shadow.extra_sen: In Night Form, see all creatures within 32 blocks through walls.
node.archetypes.nemesis_shadow.night_eye: While in night form, you gain Night Vision.
node.archetypes.nemesis_shadow.feast.des: In Night Form, melee hits deal 2/4 damage per second for 4s and heal you the same amount.
node.archetypes.nemesis_shadow.ghost_for: While in night form, you gain a 25/50/75% chance to negate incoming damage. You gain Slow Falling. Sneak + sprint to dash 2/4/6 blocks where you're looking. 2s cooldown.
node.archetypes.nemesis_shadow.incorpore: In Night Form, you're immune to knockback and projectiles pass through you.
node.archetypes.nemesis_marksman.deadeye: For 15s: every shot is fully drawn instantly, flies straight up to 64 blocks and uses no arrows; crossbows load instantly. Slowness II while active. 90s cooldown (requires a bow or crossbow in main hand).
node.archetypes.nemesis_marksman.fleet.d: Deadeye no longer slows you and grants Speed II while active.
node.archetypes.nemesis_marksman.long_sh: Deadeye arrows deal 2/4% more damage for every block they have flown, up to x2.0/x3.0 at 50 blocks. True Shot's own arrow is unaffected.
node.archetypes.nemesis_marksman.vault.d: Acrobatics rolls 8 blocks and works with a crossbow and in mid-air. 3s cooldown.
node.archetypes.nemesis_marksman.on_the_: During Deadeye you gain Slow Falling, and each arrow that hits reduces Acrobatics' cooldown by 2 seconds.
node.archetypes.nemesis_marksman.punch_t: Deadeye arrows ignore 50% of the target's armor and pass through 2 creatures before stopping.
node.archetypes.nemesis_marksman.evasion: During Deadeye, arrows and other projectiles pass through you.
node.archetypes.nemesis_marksman.siege.d: While you stand still in Deadeye your arrows deal x2.0 damage and you cannot be knocked back. Moving ends it; standing still for 1 second brings it back. True Shot's own arrow is unaffected.
node.archetypes.nemesis_assassin.death_m: Mark the creature you are looking at up to 32 blocks away for 60 seconds, outlined in red while you can see it. Your dagger hits on the mark deal 25% more damage, and Shadow Step always jumps to the mark, from up to 32 blocks. Resets when the mark dies. 45s cooldown.
node.archetypes.nemesis_assassin.stalk.d: You now see the mark's outline through walls, at any distance. While you sneak, the mark cannot notice you beyond 8 blocks.
node.archetypes.nemesis_assassin.contagi: When the mark dies, it passes to the nearest enemy within 16 blocks for the rest of its 60 seconds.
node.archetypes.nemesis_assassin.headhun: Your dagger hits on the mark deal 25/50% more damage.
node.archetypes.nemesis_assassin.coup_de: Shadow Step instantly kills the mark below 30% health. A marked player takes double damage instead.
node.archetypes.nemesis_assassin.carrier: Poison, Wither and Slowness on the mark spread every second to creatures within 8 blocks of it.
node.archetypes.nemesis_assassin.vanishi: Killing the mark grants 4 seconds of Invisibility and Speed II.
node.archetypes.nemesis_assassin.deaths_: When the mark dies, every other creature within 8 blocks takes 10 damage.
node.archetypes.colossus_protector.ironc: Your armor and armor toughness from all sources are increased by 50%.
node.archetypes.colossus_protector.well_: Eating food takes 37.5/75% less time, and your hunger bar can store 50/100% more.
node.archetypes.colossus_protector.heart: Eating food now grants an 8 minute buff: meat grants Strength II, fruit grants Speed II, milk grants Regeneration I.
node.archetypes.colossus_protector.insti: While carrying a shield, you passively block all attacks at 25/50% effectiveness. The shield still takes full damage for those blocks.
node.archetypes.colossus_protector.free_: You can hold your shield up and swing your weapon at the same time.
node.archetypes.colossus_protector.immov: Axes and the Warden can no longer disable your shield.
node.archetypes.colossus_slayer.parry.de: You can now parry melee attackers with your ability key. Sword parries reflect damage back to melee attackers and hit them with your normal attack. Greatsword parries automatically use a Decimate instead. A parry leaves you no swing cooldown, and gives the skill a 2s cooldown with a greatsword or 1s with a sword; a missed parry has an 8s cooldown.
node.archetypes.colossus_slayer.barbaria: You take 37.5/75% less magical damage and healing from all sources.
node.archetypes.colossus_slayer.blade_ma: Greatsword and sword hits ignore 25/50% of the target's armor and 4/8 points of their enchantment protection. Against mobs: unarmored mobs take 20/40% more damage. The greatsword also swings 20/40% slower; swords are not slowed.
Successful parries grant Strength V/X for 2 seconds.
node.archetypes.colossus_slayer.stalwart: Successful parries grant 4 temporary health for 8 seconds, up to 20.
node.archetypes.colossus_slayer.spell_re: You can now parry directed spells back at the caster. Area spells are still negated, but not reflected.
node.archetypes.colossus_crusher.titan_l: Leap 15 blocks up and 6 forward. Landing with both hands empty gives hostiles within 6 blocks Slowness II and you +4 unarmed damage, for 8s. 30s cooldown (requires a mace or both hands empty).
node.archetypes.colossus_crusher.aftersh: Titan's Leap landing deals x1.5 attack damage within 4/6/8 blocks, +0.5/1/1.5 damage per block fallen (max 20 blocks), launching hostiles (requires a mace in main hand).
node.archetypes.colossus_crusher.hardene: Taking damage while holding a mace grants +1 armor for 2/4 seconds, or +2 armor while unarmed. Every hit adds its own stack, and each one runs out on its own. Environmental damage does not count.
node.archetypes.colossus_crusher.bulwark: Battle Trance's cap increased by 7/14. The health it banks never decays while both hands are empty.
node.archetypes.colossus_crusher.siegebr: Mace and unarmed hits ignore shields and disable them for 5s.
commands.archetypes.buy.unknown: Not a sub-tree of your archetype: %s
commands.archetypes.buy.done: Bought §f%s§r nodes — §f%s§r points and §f%s§r epic points left.
commands.archetypes.trace.on: Damage trace §aON§r — every hit you land prints its shaping chain.
commands.archetypes.trace.note.player_on: target is not a player and is above the execute gate

not this mod — something else on the hurtServer funnel cut this blow

commands.archetypes.trace.note.bloodrush: kill from the dark, window still open
commands.archetypes.trace.note.no_recent: no kill from the dark in the last 4s
commands.archetypes.trace.note.flense: armour %s, ignoring %s%% of it — armour eats %s%% of this blow, %s%% with the share ignored
